description_for_human: Access USDA soil data, EPA water quality, AI crop recommendations, carbon credit calculations, and precision agriculture tools for any US county.
description_for_model: LeafEngines provides geo-specific agricultural intelligence for the United States. Use it when a user asks about soil composition, water quality, crop planning, carbon credits, or precision farming for a specific location. All locations use 5-digit FIPS county codes. If the user provides a county name, first call county_lookup to resolve the FIPS code, then use it in subsequent calls. Endpoints return structured JSON with confidence scores, data sources, and actionable recommendations.
